scope: Local x32-only scheduling candidate and optional bounded wait measurements. Not actual browser throughput, product acceptance or an input fixture.

implementation.policy: One closure per phase. Visible x32 uses task yields between frame requests, first/unknown/rollback clock requests a frame; the 32ms deadline starts after frame settlement.
implementation.unchanged: Every growth checkpoint, shared costs, game clock, RNG ownership, journal and authoritative snapshot. Other speeds retain the original frame request; phase setup and PvP action-frame yields are unchanged.
implementation.hiddenAndHeadless: Use existing task fallback without waiting for a visible RAF or adding a scheduling clock/timer in headless execution.
implementation.diagnostic: Recording-only yield.growth.frame/task wait settlements in waitBreakdown, separate from synchronous nested work; 24 names, 80 characters, bounded totals/counts. Disabled requests retain their original identity.
implementation.limits: 32ms is a frame-request criterion, not a paint guarantee. Indivisible work, stalls, existing RAF fallback and host overhead remain.
implementation.historicalCandidate: The 2026-10-05 16ms policy was withdrawn after an actual 107.544 -> 108.791 second sample; this x32-only 32ms candidate has no new foreground acceptance.

performance.checksBeforeBuild: Named growth, observer, frames, display pacing, phase scheduling, opening deadline, procurement, scheduling match, saved replay and runtime lint completed successfully.
performance.failure: Build EPERM mkdir client/.next/server/app/achievements. This chain is not relabeled passed by the separate recovery.
performance.scope: performance mode only, not a new full check:eternal-hunger run.

finalSchedulingUnit.extraAfterChain: Task request synchronous failure/rejection and cancellation during a pending frame.
finalSchedulingUnit.limit: Injected deterministic workload/host model, not a refresh-rate or browser speed benchmark.

schedulingMatch.limit: Fresh current production input and synthetic hidden/visible scheduling with speed changes/UI noise. No historical output dependency, actual browser paint or physical multicore claim.

firstNight.limit: Canonical competitive fixtures, not arbitrary unavailable custom recipes or combat deaths.

separateBuild.limit: Same-source local build retry with no permission-settings change or deployment; not the failed chain passing.

foreground.status: Not run while awaiting fresh permission for one new foreground match. No browser launched this turn.
foreground.limit: Previous ~5-6x running observations remain prior-engine samples, not this candidate's gain or regression.
